correctness.evidence: Noja–Pelinovsky Theorem 1.3 strict mass peak over π/2; independent soliton integration, coefficient scaling, standing-wave phase and L6 divergence.

originality.evidence: Prior paper already constructs and analyzes same mass-crossing tadpole standing-wave family; dynamics here is immediate stationary corollary.

scientific_value.evidence: No new scattering, rigidity, or stability result beyond known stationary solutions.

limitations: Operative non-scattering defined by infinite L6; no independent Strichartz-based asymptotic completeness proof
